_comment: Made by tools/parts/make_parts.py, so change the parts there. Sizes and connector spots are in the fine unit, a twentieth of a stud (see scripts/parts/grid.gd).

b_frame_sport.name: Sports bike frame
b_frame_sport.about: A sports bike frame with a twin in it, and the seat and swingarm. Put a fork on the front, a fairing too if you like, and wheels on both ends.

b_frame_dirt.name: Dirt bike frame
b_frame_dirt.about: A dirt bike frame, light, with a little single and a tall seat. Put a fork on the front and wheels on both ends.

b_frame_cruiser.name: Cruiser frame
b_frame_cruiser.about: A long, low cruiser frame with a big twin. Put a fork on the front and wheels on both ends.

b_frame_scooter.name: Scooter frame
b_frame_scooter.about: A scooter with an electric motor under the seat and a floor for your feet. Put the scooter fork on the front and small wheels on both ends.

b_frame_trike.name: Trike frame
b_frame_trike.about: A trike frame with an axle across the back for two wheels. Put a fork on the front and wheels on all three.

b_moto_fork.name: Motorbike fork
b_moto_fork.about: A front fork with the bars on top, for a motorbike frame. The bars and the front wheel turn together.

b_moto_fork_dirt.name: Dirt bike fork
b_moto_fork_dirt.about: A dirt bike's fork with high bars and a mudguard up high over the wheel.

b_moto_fork_scooter.name: Scooter fork
b_moto_fork_scooter.about: A short fork with bars and a lamp, for the scooter frame and small wheels.

s_seat.name: Driver's seat
s_seat.about: Sits the driver upright. They see everything and steer quickly, but a lot of them sticks up into the wind.

s_bucket_seat.name: Bucket seat
s_bucket_seat.about: Sits the driver lower and leaning back a little. Less of them catches the wind, and the kart sits lower.

s_racing_seat.name: Racing seat
s_racing_seat.about: Hugs the driver so they can steer their best, a little lower and leaning back a little.

s_lay_down_seat.name: Lay-down seat
s_lay_down_seat.about: The driver lies nearly flat, like on a luge. Hardly any of them is in the wind, but it's harder to steer lying down.
